items: Identifies the major system components or services with their responsibilities
Describes data flow between components or services
Includes at least one interface or API contract description between components
Identifies external integrations or third-party services used
Addresses scalability approach (horizontal scaling, load balancing, sharding, etc.)
Describes the database schema structure, major entities, or collections at a high level
Describes event or message flow if asynchronous patterns are used
Identifies failure modes, fallback mechanisms, or resilience strategies
Mentions security boundaries, authentication flow between services, or trust model
Addresses monitoring, logging, or distributed tracing architecture
